items.title: Giacomo Gates interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 29, 2015 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: That’s Mr. Williams. Big Joe Williams.

ctx.x: That’s Mr. Williams. Big Joe Williams.

We had a great relationship with him actually. He helped us get this project started. He had a relationship with Hamilton College and he got an honorary degree there, so I got to be in his presence on occasion. Those guys had an aura, some of them.
